content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42: Date, Start Time, Location, Match Card, Participants, History, News, and Updates
content.text: PHOTO BY MIKE MARQUES/WWE VIA GETTY IMAGESWWE WrestleMania 42: Date, Location, Match Card, News, and Everything to KnowJohn Cena will return to WWE as the host of WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas.WrestleMania is the WWE’s biggest event of the year, bringing captivating rivalries and the culminations of long-standing feuds to a head in high-stakes clashes and championship showdowns that create unforgettable moments on the grandest stage of them all. WrestleMania 42 is shaping up to be a monumental weekend, with a stacked card featuring the biggest superstars and plenty of WWE titles on the line. This is your guide to everything you need to know before the two-night spectacle hits Las Vegas in April.Scroll on for all the confirmed details so far and check back here as more matches and updates get announced.WrestleMania 42 card:CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight ChampionshipStephanie Vaquer vs. Liv Morgan for the Women’s World ChampionshipJade Cargill vs. Rhea Ripley for the WWE Women’s ChampionshipCody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE ChampionshipBrock Lesnar vs. Oba FemiAJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch for the Women’s Intercontinental ChampionshipJacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyreSami Zayn vs. Trick Williams for the United States ChampionshipAlexa Bliss and Charlotte Flar vs. Bayley and Lyra Valkyrua vs. Nia Jax and Lash Legend vs. Brie Bella and Nikki Bella in a Fatal-4Way for the WWE Women's Tag Team ChampionshipFinn Bálor vs. Dominik MysterioPenta vs. Je’Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. Rusev vs. JD McDonagh in a Ladder Match for the Intercontinental Championship Seth Rollins vs. GuntherSorry, this content requires third-party cookie consent to view.View your cookie preferences here.Will John Cena be at WrestleMania 42?John Cena has announced that he’ll return to host WrestleMania in his first WWE appearance since Dec. 13 when he was defeated by Gunther in his retirement match.Who will be Brock Lesnar’s opponent at WrestleMania 42?During the March 16 episode of Raw, Oba Femi stepped up and hit Brock Lesnar with a Fall From Grace pop-up powerbomb and it was announced that the two will face off at WrestleMania 42. Learn more about Femi here.Sorry, this content requires third-party cookie consent to view.View your cookie preferences here.When is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 Night 1 is Saturday, April 18WrestleMania 42 Night 2 is Sunday, April 19Where is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 will take place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.How to watch WrestleMania 42:WrestleMania 42 streams on ESPN in the United States. However, members in the following countries and regions will be able to tune in live on Netflix:Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Ecuador, Egypt, Finland, Greece, Hong Kong, Hungary, Indonesia, Israel, Kuwait, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, and United Kingdom.For the first time in WrestleMania history, the opening hour of each night will air live on cable TV, Saturday on ESPN2 and Sunday on ESPN, before fully shifting to streaming.Make sure to catch an action-packed episode of Raw after WrestleMania, streaming on Netflix April 20 at 5 p.m. PT / 8 p.m. ET. Click here for more details on the upcoming episode of Raw.How to buy WrestleMania tickets:Check here for tickets to WrestleMania 42 and other upcoming WWE events.Can I watch previous WrestleMania events on Netflix?Yes, every WrestleMania in WWE history is streaming on Netflix. Click here to open the complete WrestleMania Vault. Every WrestleMania main event in history:Since 1985, the main event of WrestleMania has featured WWE’s biggest superstars competing in the most anticipated matches of the year. These headline bouts often determine championships, settle long-running rivalries, and create iconic moments cherished and revisited by fans in years to come.
